source.content: @isTest private class CoreFeatureManagementFixtureTest { @isTest static void permissionAndProtection() { System.runAs(new User(Id = '005-user-fm', Username = 'fm@example.test', Permissions = 'CanRunLocal')) { System.assert(FeatureManagement.checkPermission('CanRunLocal')); System.assert(!FeatureManagement.checkPermission('OtherPermission')); FeatureManagement.changeProtection('LocalFeature', 'CustomPermission', 'Protected'); } } @isTest static void packageValuesRoundTrip() { System.assertEquals(false, System.FeatureManagement.checkPackageBooleanValue('LocalBooleanFeature')); System.FeatureManagement.setPackageBooleanValue('LocalBooleanFeature', true); System.assertEquals(true, System.FeatureManagement.checkPackageBooleanValue('LocalBooleanFeature')); System.FeatureManagement.setPackageIntegerValue('LocalIntegerFeature', 7); System.assertEquals(7, System.FeatureManagement.checkPackageIntegerValue('LocalIntegerFeature')); System.FeatureManagement.setPackageDateValue('LocalDateFeature', Date.newInstance(2026, 6, 3)); System.assertEquals(Date.newInstance(2026, 6, 3), System.FeatureManagement.checkPackageDateValue('LocalDateFeature')); System.assertEquals(null, System.FeatureManagement.checkPackageDateValue('MissingLocalDateFeature')); } }
